messages:
ivy: promo stalled during CI prefetch. deploy-bot stuck on cache pull with repeated 504s. change window open (~12m). need quick decision.
kevin: confirming. artifact lives in registry; prefetch is the only failing step (backoff attempts).
deploy-bot: automated: promotion job=promo-771 state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=5/10 last_error=504 Gateway Timeout. next_retry_in=35s.
sam-oncall: looking at cache-service. frontends show a backlog to the s3 proxy; threads are pinned. trying a rolling recycle of the proxy workers now.
maria: if infra can't stabilize within 10m we should either abort or do a manual activate with pin+skip-prefetch. prefer to use the window.
olivia: agree. recommend manual promote + immediate smoke + canary 3% for 20m. also add a brief rollback runbook entry in the release notes.
kevin: deploy-bot has `--skip-cache-prefetch` and `--force-activate` flags. a manual command would be: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:9f8e7d6c5b --skip-cache-prefetch --force-activate --tag manual-force-2026-03-21`. tested the flow on staging yesterday.
ivy: infra OK with that, provided we have rollback immediate steps. sam, do you expect cache to recover soon?
sam-oncall: after a single worker recycle latency dropped a bit, 504 rate went from ~17% -> ~4% in 90s. still flaky. opening incident INC-2026-03-cache-54 (suspected s3-proxy thread starvation).
kevin: executing manual promote now per approval. job queued as promo-772.
deploy-bot: update: promo-772 started. params: skip_prefetch=true force_activate=true tag=manual-force-2026-03-21. stage=artifact_activation -> in-progress.
deploy-bot: success: promo-772 completed. prod image=sha256:9f8e7d6c5b. tag=manual-force-2026-03-21. label=manual_force_activate.
maria: starting smoke checks and enabling 3% canary. watching 5xx dashboard and p95 latency.
olivia: adding release note: "Manual promotion due to recurring cache prefetch 504s; promoted sha256:9f8e7d6c5b; prefetch skipped, forced activation. Canary 3% for 20m. Rollback target: sha256:1a2b3c4d5e." pushed to release doc.
kevin: rollback playbook added to release doc and support is on pager. also noted `--force-activate` should be used sparingly.
sam-oncall: proxy restarts continue; 504s down to ~1.2% and holding. will follow up with a postmortem and mitigation (tune proxy thread timeout + add health-check draining).
ivy: follow-ups: (1) add prefetch circuit-breaker to deploy-bot to auto-fall back to manual path after N retries, (2) document `--force-activate` + `--skip-cache-prefetch` flow in deploy docs, (3) postmortem for cache-service. pinning this thread to the release doc and closing the promo hold while canary runs. :white_check_mark:
